sources.title: Bidet AI — on-device Gemma 4 brain-dump cleanup for Android
sources.snippet: Bidet AI is a solo project. It records single-speaker speech on an Android phone, transcribes it on-device with a small dedicated speech model (Moonshine-Tiny via sherpa-onnx), and then uses Gemma 4 running locally via LiteRT-LM to restructure the raw transcript into readable, organized output.
